description.zh: 要查询的地址。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询已添加的地址。
description.en: The address to query. You can set this parameter to perform a fuzzy match on added addresses.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-500，默认值为20。
description.en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 下一页查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的**NextToken**参数值。首页查询无需传入。
description.en: The pagination token for the next page. Set this parameter to the value of **NextToken** returned in the previous API call. Leave this parameter empty for the first page.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.
The ID of the address book to query.

title.en: Query address book addresses by page

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-addresses --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --rule-id 12345678 --address-like 1.2.3.3 --next-token AAAAAGBgV9tolsLfijC4wam2htS00000D/46H3X2wIS --max-results 20 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm4gh0000wela --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
